stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.en: Advocating Against Unsafe Premature Discharge in Acute Decompensated Heart Failure
title.zh: 急性失代偿性心衰中反对不安全过早出院的患者倡导

summary.en: A 71-year-old client recovering from acute decompensated heart failure has an active discharge order despite unresolved functional, comprehension, medication-access, social, environmental, and clinical monitoring concerns.
summary.zh: 一名 71 岁急性失代偿性心衰恢复期患者已有有效出院医嘱，但仍存在功能、理解、用药取得、社会、环境和临床监测方面未解决的担忧。

title.zh: 入院背景与出院情境

content.en: A 71-year-old woman with HFrEF (EF 30%), type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and mild CKD was admitted 4 days ago for acute decompensated heart failure after running out of furosemide because she could not afford the refill. She was treated with IV furosemide, transitioned to new oral torsemide 40 mg daily, had lisinopril increased to 20 mg daily, and received a new carvedilol prescription. She lives alone in a second-floor walk-up apartment with no elevator and has no home scale. Her daughter lives 90 minutes away and works full-time. The attending entered a discharge order this morning with a target discharge time of 11:00 AM during bed-throughput pressure.
content.zh: 一名 71 岁女性，有射血分数降低型心衰（EF 30%）、2 型糖尿病、高血压和轻度慢性肾病。4 天前因买不起 furosemide 续药而停药，发生急性失代偿性心衰入院。住院期间接受 IV furosemide，改为新的口服 torsemide 40 mg 每日一次，lisinopril 增至每日 20 mg，并新增 carvedilol。她独居在无电梯的二楼公寓，家中没有体重秤；女儿住在 90 分钟路程外且全职工作。由于床位周转压力，医生今晨开立出院医嘱，目标上午 11:00 出院。

title.en: Morning assessment and laboratory data at 07:15
title.zh: 07:15 早晨评估与实验室资料

content.en: The client is fatigued and slightly short of breath while talking. Vital signs: T 36.8 C, HR 92 regular, BP 108/68, RR 22, SpO2 93% on room air. Weight today 78.2 kg; admission weight 84.6 kg; yesterday 79.0 kg. Fine crackles remain at the lung bases, trace bilateral pedal edema, no visible JVD at 45 degrees, warm/dry skin, capillary refill 2 seconds. She reports mild dizziness after sitting up to use the commode. No chest pain; alert and oriented. Labs: Na 138, K 3.4, Cl 96, CO2 30, BUN 38, creatinine 1.8 mg/dL (baseline outpatient 1.4; admission 1.6), glucose 142, BNP 680 pg/mL (admission 2,400; yesterday 820), Hgb 11.4, WBC 7.2, platelets 210, Mg 1.7, INR 1.0, albumin 3.0.
content.zh: 患者疲惫，讲话时略感气短。生命体征：T 36.8 C，HR 92 次/分且规则，BP 108/68，RR 22 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 93%。今日体重 78.2 kg；入院 84.6 kg；昨日 79.0 kg。双肺底仍有细湿啰音，双足轻微水肿，45 度时无可见颈静脉怒张，皮肤温暖干燥，毛细血管再充盈 2 秒。她报告坐起使用便盆后有轻度头晕。无胸痛；意识清楚，定向力正常。实验室：Na 138，K 3.4，Cl 96，CO2 30，BUN 38，肌酐 1.8 mg/dL（门诊基线 1.4；入院 1.6），葡萄糖 142，BNP 680 pg/mL（入院 2,400；昨日 820），Hgb 11.4，WBC 7.2，血小板 210，Mg 1.7，INR 1.0，白蛋白 3.0。

title.en: Stage 1: 07:30-09:00, discharge teaching and ambulation trial
title.zh: 第 1 阶段：07:30-09:00，出院教育与步行试验

title.en: Teach-back, medication access, and functional tolerance
title.zh: 回授、用药取得与功能耐受

content.en: During teach-back, the client says torsemide may be for blood pressure, is unsure what to do for weight gain over 2 lb overnight, and cannot name warning signs that should prompt calling the provider. She asks whether torsemide is the same as furosemide and whether insurance will cover it. Pharmacy test claim shows a $95/month copay for the new diuretic. She says she lives on about $1,400/month and could not afford furosemide last month, which is why she stopped taking it. Ambulation trial: after about 40 feet, she stops, grips the handrail, and says she is very winded. HR 110, RR 28, SpO2 89% on room air. She requires 2 minutes of rest and oxygen 2 L/min by nasal cannula to recover to SpO2 93%. She states her apartment is up one flight of stairs and she does not know how she would make it. Five minutes after returning to bed: HR 96, RR 24, SpO2 92% on room air. At 08:45, bed management asks whether the bed will be available by 11:00 because 3 emergency department patients are boarding for telemetry beds.
content.zh: 回授时，患者说 torsemide 可能是降血压药，不确定如果一夜体重增加超过 2 lb 该怎么做，也说不出哪些警示症状需要联系医护人员。她询问 torsemide 是否和 furosemide 一样，以及保险是否会支付。药房试算显示新的利尿剂每月自付 95 美元。她表示每月社会保障收入约 1,400 美元，上月因买不起 furosemide 才停药。步行试验：约 40 英尺后，她停下抓住扶手，说非常喘。HR 110，RR 28，室内空气 SpO2 89%。她需要休息 2 分钟并经鼻导管吸氧 2 L/min，才恢复至 SpO2 93%。她说自己的公寓要上一层楼，不知道自己能否做到。回床休息 5 分钟后：HR 96，RR 24，室内空气 SpO2 92%。08:45，床位管理询问该床是否能在 11:00 空出，因为急诊有 3 名患者在等待监护床位。

title.zh: 第 2 阶段：09:00-11:30，倡导与跨专业介入
暂缓出院并启动资源

content.en: The nurse documents ambulation findings, failed teach-back, medication affordability barrier, and home environment concerns. At 09:15, the nurse calls the attending and reports that the client desaturates to 89% with minimal exertion, cannot demonstrate understanding of the new regimen, cannot afford the diuretic, lives alone, lacks a scale, and must climb stairs. The attending initially cites length of stay, downtrending BNP, and bed need. The nurse respectfully reiterates patient-safety concerns and states she will escalate through chain of command if the discharge order is not modified. The attending agrees to hold discharge for interdisciplinary evaluation. The nurse pages the case manager, requests social work, contacts the clinical pharmacist for formulary or assistance options, places a home health referral, and contacts the daughter. By 10:30, pharmacy identifies a covered generic loop-diuretic alternative; social work identifies a scale program and home-safety evaluation; home health accepts the referral for the day after discharge; the daughter arranges to stay for 2 days.
content.zh: 护士记录步行发现、回授失败、用药负担障碍和居家环境担忧。09:15，护士致电主治医生，报告患者少量活动即 SpO2 降至 89%，不能说明新用药方案，负担不起利尿剂，独居、没有体重秤且需要爬楼。医生最初以住院天数、BNP 下降和床位需求为理由。护士尊重地重申患者安全担忧，并说明若出院医嘱不修改，将按逐级上报流程处理。医生同意暂缓出院，等待跨专业评估。护士呼叫个案管理师，请求社工会诊，联系临床药师寻找目录内或援助方案，申请居家护理，并联系女儿。10:30 前，药师找到保险覆盖的通用袢利尿剂替代方案；社工找到体重秤项目并安排居家安全评估；居家护理接受转诊并安排出院次日上门；女儿安排陪伴 2 天。

title.en: Stage 3: Next morning 08:00-11:00, re-evaluation and modified discharge
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：次日 08:00-11:00，重新评估与修改后出院
干预后的重新评估

content.en: The provider orders potassium and magnesium repletion, repeat labs, and an additional loop-diuretic dose. Next morning resting vitals: HR 82, BP 112/70, RR 18, SpO2 95% on room air. Weight 77.4 kg. At 09:00, the client walks 150 feet and completes simulated stair climbing with HR 98, RR 22, SpO2 92% on room air; she recovers to baseline within 1 minute without oxygen. On repeat teach-back, she correctly states that the diuretic is her water pill, that she should weigh herself every morning, and that she should call for weight gain over 2 lb in 1 day or 3 lb in 1 week. She names increased leg swelling, waking up short of breath, and needing more pillows to sleep as warning signs. She states the medication names, doses, and timing, and confirms her daughter will stay for 2 days, home health will visit the day after discharge, a scale is being delivered, her prescription was revised, a 30-day diuretic supply is in hand, and cardiology follow-up is in 5 days. Labs: K 4.1, Mg 2.0, creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, BNP 520 pg/mL.
content.zh: 医生医嘱补充钾和镁、复查实验室，并再给一次袢利尿剂。次日早晨静息生命体征：HR 82，BP 112/70，RR 18，室内空气 SpO2 95%。体重 77.4 kg。09:00，患者步行 150 英尺并完成模拟爬楼，HR 98，RR 22，室内空气 SpO2 92%；无需吸氧，1 分钟内恢复基线。再次回授时，她正确说明利尿剂是“排水药”，应每天早晨称体重；若 1 天增加超过 2 lb 或 1 周增加 3 lb 应联系医护人员。她能说出警示症状：腿部肿胀增加、夜间气短醒来、需要更多枕头睡觉。她能说出药名、剂量和时间，并确认女儿将陪伴 2 天、居家护理出院次日上门、体重秤将送达、处方已修改、手中有 30 天利尿剂供应，且 5 天后心脏科随访。实验室：K 4.1，Mg 2.0，肌酐 1.6 mg/dL，BNP 520 pg/mL。

stem.en: Using the Stage 1 information, highlight the findings that are red flags for unsafe discharge today.
stem.zh: 根据第 1 阶段资料，标出提示今天出院不安全的危险信号。

segments.en: The client is alert and oriented to person, place, time, and situation.
segments.zh: 患者对人、地点、时间和情况均定向力正常。

segments.en: Resting RR is 22/min with SpO2 93% on room air.
segments.zh: 静息时呼吸频率 22 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 为 93%。

segments.en: Weight decreased from 84.6 kg on admission to 78.2 kg today.
segments.zh: 体重从入院时 84.6 kg 降至今天 78.2 kg。

segments.en: Jugular venous distension is no longer visible at 45 degrees.
segments.zh: 床头抬高 45 度时已看不到颈静脉怒张。

segments.en: Bilateral pedal edema improved from 2+ on admission to trace today.
segments.zh: 双侧足部水肿从入院时 2+ 改善为轻微。

segments.en: During hallway ambulation of about 40 feet, SpO2 decreased to 89% on room air and oxygen was needed for recovery.
segments.zh: 在走廊步行约 40 英尺时，室内空气 SpO2 降至 89%，需要吸氧后才恢复。

segments.en: The client cannot explain the purpose of torsemide, what to do for sudden weight gain, or which symptoms require calling the provider.
segments.zh: 患者无法说明 torsemide 的用途、体重突然增加时该怎么做，或哪些症状需要联系医护人员。

segments.en: The new diuretic has a $95/month copay, and medication cost was the reason she stopped her prior furosemide.
segments.zh: 新的利尿剂每月自付 95 美元，而药费负担正是她之前停用 furosemide 的原因。

segments.en: She lives alone in a second-floor walk-up apartment and has no home scale.
segments.zh: 她独居在没有电梯的二楼公寓，家中没有体重秤。

segments.en: BNP decreased from 2,400 pg/mL on admission to 680 pg/mL today.
segments.zh: BNP 从入院时 2,400 pg/mL 降至今天 680 pg/mL。

segments.en: Creatinine is 1.8 mg/dL, above her outpatient baseline of 1.4 mg/dL.
segments.zh: 肌酐为 1.8 mg/dL，高于门诊基线 1.4 mg/dL。

correct.en: The unsafe-discharge cues are residual respiratory compromise, exertional desaturation requiring oxygen recovery, failed teach-back, unaffordable diuretic therapy, unsafe home environment/no scale, and creatinine above baseline. Improving weight, edema, JVD, and BNP show treatment response but do not prove discharge readiness.
correct.zh: 出院不安全的线索包括仍有呼吸受限、活动后低氧且需吸氧恢复、回授失败、利尿剂负担不起、居家环境/无体重秤不安全，以及肌酐高于基线。体重、水肿、颈静脉怒张和 BNP 改善说明治疗有效，但不能证明已具备出院准备。

byChoice.en: Normal orientation is reassuring and does not by itself make the discharge unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 定向力正常是令人放心的资料，本身不是出院不安全的原因。

byChoice.en: Borderline resting oxygenation with tachypnea shows residual respiratory compromise before the exertion required at home.
byChoice.zh: 静息氧合临界且呼吸偏快，提示在回家所需活动前仍有呼吸储备不足。

byChoice.en: The weight loss shows response to diuresis, but it does not prove that the client can manage safely at home.
byChoice.zh: 体重下降说明利尿治疗有效，但不能证明患者能在家安全管理。

byChoice.en: Resolved JVD supports improvement in congestion; it is not a discharge barrier.
byChoice.zh: 颈静脉怒张消退支持淤血改善，不是出院障碍。

byChoice.en: Improved edema is a positive treatment response, not an active barrier.
byChoice.zh: 水肿改善是治疗有效的表现，不是当前障碍。

byChoice.en: Desaturation with only minimal ambulation and need for oxygen recovery directly conflict with the stairs and exertion required at home.
byChoice.zh: 仅少量步行即低氧并需吸氧恢复，直接不符合其回家后需要爬楼和活动的要求。

byChoice.en: Failed teach-back means the client cannot yet carry out the medication, weight-monitoring, and symptom-response plan independently.
byChoice.zh: 回授失败说明患者尚不能独立执行用药、体重监测和症状处理计划。

byChoice.en: Unaffordable diuretic therapy recreates the same adherence barrier that precipitated the admission.
byChoice.zh: 利尿剂负担不起会重现导致本次入院的同一服药障碍。

byChoice.en: Living alone, stairs, and no scale create environmental and monitoring barriers for heart-failure self-management.
byChoice.zh: 独居、楼梯和没有体重秤构成心衰自我管理的环境与监测障碍。

byChoice.en: A falling BNP supports improvement, but biomarkers do not override functional, comprehension, and access barriers.
byChoice.zh: BNP 下降支持病情改善，但生物标志物不能抵消功能、理解和用药取得方面的障碍。

byChoice.en: Creatinine above baseline during ongoing diuresis signals unresolved renal-risk monitoring before discharge.
byChoice.zh: 在继续利尿时肌酐高于基线，提示出院前仍需关注肾功能风险。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge-readiness questions, separate evidence of treatment response from evidence that the client can safely carry out the plan at home.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做出院准备度题时，要把“治疗有反应”和“患者能否在家安全执行计划”分开判断。

glossary.defZh: 患者是否能在生理、功能、理解、用药取得和居家支持方面安全出院。
让患者用自己的话复述教育重点，以确认理解。
心衰评估中常用的血液指标；下降可提示治疗反应，但不能单独决定出院安全。

stem.en: For each Stage 1 finding, classify whether it is an active barrier to safe discharge or a resolved/improving finding that does not remove the other barriers.
stem.zh: 对每个第 1 阶段发现进行分类：它是安全出院的当前障碍，还是已改善/非障碍且不能抵消其他风险的发现。

rows.en: SpO2 decreases to 89% after 40 feet of ambulation.
rows.zh: 步行 40 英尺后 SpO2 降至 89%。

rows.en: JVD is no longer visible at 45 degrees.
rows.zh: 床头抬高 45 度时已看不到颈静脉怒张。

rows.en: The client cannot identify when to call the provider for weight gain or symptoms.
rows.zh: 患者无法说明体重增加或症状出现时何时联系医护人员。

rows.en: The new diuretic costs $95/month and is not affordable.
rows.zh: 新的利尿剂每月 95 美元，患者负担不起。

rows.en: Weight is down 6.4 kg since admission and 0.8 kg since yesterday.
rows.zh: 体重较入院下降 6.4 kg，较昨天下降 0.8 kg。

rows.en: The client lives alone in a second-floor walk-up apartment.
rows.zh: 患者独居在没有电梯的二楼公寓。

rows.en: Creatinine is 1.8 mg/dL, above a baseline of 1.4 mg/dL.
rows.zh: 肌酐 1.8 mg/dL，高于基线 1.4 mg/dL。

rows.en: The client is afebrile and has no chest pain.
rows.zh: 患者无发热且无胸痛。

rows.en: Potassium is 3.4 mEq/L while loop diuretic therapy is continuing.
rows.zh: 继续使用袢利尿剂时钾为 3.4 mEq/L。

rows.en: BNP is trending down from 2,400 to 680 pg/mL.
rows.zh: BNP 从 2,400 pg/mL 降至 680 pg/mL。

columns.en: Resolved/improving or not a discharge barrier

correct.en: Active barriers include exertional hypoxemia, failed self-management understanding, medication unaffordability, unsafe home environment/lack of support, creatinine above baseline, and low-normal potassium during diuresis. Improving congestion markers and reassuring negatives do not make discharge safe by themselves.
correct.zh: 当前障碍包括活动后低氧、自我管理理解失败、药物负担不起、居家环境/支持不足、肌酐高于基线，以及利尿期间钾偏低正常。淤血指标改善和阴性体征本身不能说明出院安全。

byChoice.en: Exertional desaturation is a functional and physiologic barrier, especially with stairs at home.
byChoice.zh: 活动后低氧是功能和生理障碍，尤其患者家中需要爬楼。

byChoice.en: Resolved JVD is an improvement in congestion, not a current barrier.
byChoice.zh: 颈静脉怒张消退是淤血改善，不是当前障碍。

byChoice.en: Inability to state weight and symptom actions is a comprehension barrier to self-management.
byChoice.zh: 无法说明体重和症状处理措施，是自我管理的理解障碍。

byChoice.en: Medication non-affordability is a direct clinical barrier because it caused the current decompensation.
byChoice.zh: 药物负担不起是直接临床障碍，因为它导致了本次失代偿。

byChoice.en: Weight loss shows response to therapy; it does not remove the discharge barriers.
byChoice.zh: 体重下降说明治疗有反应，但不能消除出院障碍。

byChoice.en: Stairs and living alone are environmental/social barriers when the client cannot tolerate minimal ambulation.
byChoice.zh: 当患者不能耐受少量步行时，楼梯和独居就是环境/社会障碍。

byChoice.en: Creatinine above baseline is an unresolved clinical monitoring concern during diuresis.
byChoice.zh: 利尿期间肌酐高于基线，是未解决的临床监测问题。

byChoice.en: Afebrile status and no chest pain are reassuring findings, not active discharge barriers.
byChoice.zh: 无发热、无胸痛是令人放心的资料，不是当前出院障碍。

byChoice.en: Low-normal potassium during loop-diuretic therapy can worsen with continued diuresis and needs correction/monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 使用袢利尿剂时钾偏低正常，继续利尿可能进一步下降，需要补充或监测。

byChoice.en: Downtrending BNP supports improved heart-failure status but does not prove safe transition home.
byChoice.zh: BNP 下降支持心衰改善，但不能证明能安全过渡回家。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a question asks you to classify cues, do not let a single improving trend erase barriers in other domains.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当题目要求分类线索时，不要让单一改善趋势掩盖其他领域的障碍。

glossary.defZh: 若未解决会直接影响出院安全的生理、功能、认知、经济或环境问题。
用于排出多余液体的药物，可能影响钾、镁和肾功能。
经济能力、住房、交通、社会支持等会影响健康结局的非医学因素。

stem.en: The attending cites the downtrending BNP and the need for the bed as reasons to proceed. What is the nurse's priority advocacy stance?
stem.zh: 医生以 BNP 下降和需要床位为理由要求继续出院。护士优先的倡导立场是什么？

options.en: Give extra written instructions and avoid challenging the provider because the discharge order is active.
options.zh: 提供更多书面说明，不质疑医嘱，因为出院医嘱已经生效。

options.en: Advocate to hold or modify the discharge because the plan is unsafe despite improving biomarkers.
options.zh: 主张暂缓或修改出院计划，因为尽管指标改善，目前计划仍不安全。

options.en: Proceed with discharge because the BNP is lower and the client has completed four hospital days.
options.zh: 因 BNP 降低且已住院四天，所以按计划出院。

options.en: Delay advocacy until bed management confirms whether an emergency department patient still needs the bed.
options.zh: 等床位管理确认急诊患者是否仍需要床位后再进行倡导。

correct.en: The priority concern is patient safety. The nurse should communicate the specific barriers and request that discharge be held or modified pending interdisciplinary evaluation. Bed pressure and improving biomarkers do not override unsafe functional, comprehension, medication-access, and home-environment findings.
correct.zh: 优先问题是患者安全。护士应沟通具体障碍，并请求暂缓或修改出院，等待跨专业评估。床位压力和指标改善不能超过功能、理解、用药取得和居家环境方面的不安全发现。

byChoice.en: Throughput pressure is not the priority. Advocacy should not wait for operational confirmation when patient safety barriers are present.
byChoice.zh: 床位周转压力不是优先事项；出现患者安全障碍时，倡导不应等待运营确认。

byChoice.en: Length of stay and a lower BNP do not override failed ambulation, failed teach-back, unaffordable medication, and unsafe home conditions.
byChoice.zh: 住院天数和 BNP 降低不能抵消步行失败、回授失败、药物负担不起和居家不安全。

byChoice.en: This focuses on the nurse's duty to protect client safety and uses objective barriers to request a discharge hold or modification.
byChoice.zh: 这体现护士保护患者安全的职责，并用客观障碍请求暂缓或修改出院。

byChoice.en: Written materials alone do not fix demonstrated misunderstanding, and the nurse should speak up when an active order threatens safety.
byChoice.zh: 单靠书面资料不能解决已证实的理解不足；当有效医嘱威胁安全时护士应发声。

testTakingStrategy.en: When the stem includes operational pressure, ask whether it conflicts with client safety. Safety wins.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 题干出现运营压力时，先判断它是否与患者安全冲突。患者安全优先。

glossary.defZh: 护士代表患者安全和权益发声，并推动解决风险。
因床位或流程需求而推动快速出院或转运的运营压力。

stem.en: Which nursing actions address the identified Stage 1 discharge barriers? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哪些护理措施可以处理第 1 阶段识别出的出院障碍？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Arrange home health nursing and coordinate immediate family support.
options.zh: 安排居家护理，并协调近期家属支持。

options.en: Contact the case manager about transition needs, insurance coverage, and discharge resources.
options.zh: 联系个案管理师评估过渡需求、保险覆盖和出院资源。

options.en: Discharge the client as ordered to free the telemetry bed and rely on written instructions.
options.zh: 按医嘱让患者出院以腾出监护床位，并依赖书面说明。

options.en: Ask the clinical pharmacist to identify an affordable formulary alternative or assistance program.
options.zh: 请临床药师寻找可负担的目录内替代药或援助项目。

options.en: Request social work support for home resources, a scale, and home-safety evaluation.
options.zh: 请求社工协助居家资源、体重秤和居家安全评估。

options.en: Document the ambulation result, failed teach-back, medication-cost barrier, and home-safety concerns.
options.zh: 记录步行结果、回授失败、药费障碍和居家安全担忧。

correct.en: The nurse should document, involve case management, social work, pharmacy, home health, and family support. These actions target the functional, comprehension, financial, and environmental barriers. Discharging to meet a bed target is unsafe.
correct.zh: 护士应记录情况，并联络个案管理、社工、药师、居家护理和家属支持。这些措施分别处理功能、理解、经济和环境障碍。为了床位目标出院是不安全的。

byChoice.en: Pharmacy involvement targets the exact medication-access problem that caused the admission.
byChoice.zh: 药师介入针对导致入院的核心用药取得问题。

byChoice.en: Proceeding to free a bed ignores unresolved safety barriers and repeats the conditions that led to decompensation.
byChoice.zh: 为腾床出院会忽视未解决的安全障碍，并重现导致失代偿的条件。

byChoice.en: Social work addresses the community and home-environment barriers that make the current plan unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 社工可处理使当前计划不安全的社区与居家环境障碍。

byChoice.en: Documentation preserves the objective safety record and supports provider communication and escalation if needed.
byChoice.zh: 记录可保留客观安全资料，并支持与医生沟通及必要时上报。

byChoice.en: Case management can address insurance, resources, and transition-of-care planning.
byChoice.zh: 个案管理可处理保险、资源和过渡护理计划。

byChoice.en: Home health and family support provide monitoring and immediate assistance after discharge.
byChoice.zh: 居家护理和家属支持可在出院后提供监测和即时帮助。

testTakingStrategy.en: For multi-domain discharge barriers, choose the actions that match each barrier; avoid one-resource answers for a multi-resource problem.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 面对多领域出院障碍时，选择能对应每个障碍的措施；多资源问题不要只选单一资源。

glossary.defZh: 协调保险、资源、转诊和过渡护理计划的成员。
帮助优化用药、评估相互作用、剂量和可负担性的药学人员。
评估住所是否适合患者当前功能能力和护理需求的检查。

stem.en: The discharge order is active with a target discharge time of 11:00 AM. After identifying the unsafe discharge picture, what should the nurse do first?
stem.zh: 出院医嘱已生效，目标出院时间为上午 11:00。识别出出院不安全后，护士首先应怎么做？

options.en: Escalate directly to the nursing supervisor before speaking with the attending physician.
options.zh: 在联系主治医生前直接上报护理主管。

options.en: Call the daughter first to see if she can solve the transportation and stair problem.
options.zh: 先致电女儿，看她是否能解决交通和爬楼问题。

options.en: Call the attending physician with the objective safety concerns and request that the discharge order be held.
options.zh: 致电主治医生说明客观安全担忧，并请求暂缓出院医嘱。

options.en: Page the social worker first because financial and home barriers are the root causes.
options.zh: 先呼叫社工，因为经济和居家障碍是根本原因。

correct.en: The first action is direct communication with the ordering provider to request a discharge hold. This stops the unsafe process and creates time for case management, social work, pharmacy, home health, and family coordination. Escalation follows if the provider refuses to address the safety concern.
correct.zh: 首要措施是直接联系开立医嘱的医生，请求暂缓出院。这样才能停止不安全流程，并争取时间协调个案管理、社工、药师、居家护理和家属。若医生拒绝处理安全问题，再逐级上报。

byChoice.en: The active discharge order must be paused first so there is time to mobilize the interdisciplinary resources safely.
byChoice.zh: 必须先暂停已经生效的出院医嘱，才能安全争取时间调动跨专业资源。

byChoice.en: Chain-of-command escalation is appropriate if the provider will not address the concern; the first step is direct provider communication.
byChoice.zh: 若医生不处理担忧，逐级上报是合适的；第一步应先直接与医生沟通。

byChoice.en: Family support is important, but it cannot replace provider modification of the unsafe discharge order.
byChoice.zh: 家属支持很重要，但不能替代医生修改不安全的出院医嘱。

byChoice.en: Social work is needed, but calling social work first does not stop the active 11:00 discharge process.
byChoice.zh: 社工确实需要介入，但先找社工不能阻止 11:00 的有效出院流程。

testTakingStrategy.en: When an unsafe process is already moving, choose the action that pauses the unsafe process before arranging secondary supports.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当不安全流程已经启动时，应先选择能暂停该流程的措施，再安排后续支持。

glossary.defZh: 已经由医生开立、可能被执行的医嘱。
初步沟通未解决安全问题时，按政策寻求更高层级协助。

stem.en: Using the Stage 3 re-evaluation, classify each finding as evidence that a specific discharge barrier has been resolved/controlled or as supportive treatment-response data that is not sufficient alone.
stem.zh: 根据第 3 阶段重新评估，将每项发现分类为“证明某个出院障碍已解决/受控”，或“有帮助但单独不足的治疗反应资料”。

rows.en: Ambulates 150 feet and completes simulated stairs with SpO2 92% on room air, recovering within 1 minute.
rows.zh: 步行 150 英尺并完成模拟楼梯，室内空气 SpO2 为 92%，1 分钟内恢复。

rows.en: Correctly explains the diuretic purpose, daily weight plan, call parameters, and warning signs.
rows.zh: 正确说明利尿剂用途、每日称重计划、联系医护的参数和警示症状。

rows.en: The prescription is revised and a 30-day diuretic supply is provided before discharge.
rows.zh: 处方已修改，且出院前已提供 30 天利尿剂供应。

rows.en: Daughter will stay for two days, home health visit is scheduled, scale delivery is arranged, and cardiology follow-up is confirmed.
rows.zh: 女儿将陪伴两天，已安排居家护理、体重秤配送，并确认心脏科随访。

rows.en: Creatinine improves from 1.8 to 1.6 mg/dL, potassium is 4.1 mEq/L, and resting SpO2 is 95%.
rows.zh: 肌酐从 1.8 改善至 1.6 mg/dL，钾为 4.1 mEq/L，静息 SpO2 为 95%。

rows.en: BNP has decreased to 520 pg/mL.
rows.zh: BNP 已降至 520 pg/mL。

columns.en: Evidence a specific discharge barrier is resolved or controlled
columns.zh: 证明某个出院障碍已解决或受控

columns.en: Helpful treatment-response data but not sufficient alone
columns.zh: 有帮助的治疗反应资料，但单独不足

correct.en: By Stage 3, the functional, comprehension, medication-access, support/equipment, and clinical-stability barriers have concrete resolutions. BNP is still helpful as treatment-response information, but it remains insufficient by itself to establish discharge readiness.
correct.zh: 到第 3 阶段，功能、理解、用药取得、支持/设备和临床稳定性障碍都有具体解决结果。BNP 仍是有帮助的治疗反应资料，但单独仍不足以证明出院准备充分。

byChoice.en: This directly verifies functional tolerance for walking and stairs without clinically significant desaturation.
byChoice.zh: 这直接验证患者能耐受步行和楼梯，且无临床上显著的低氧。

byChoice.en: Successful teach-back resolves the comprehension barrier to self-management.
byChoice.zh: 回授成功解决了自我管理理解障碍。

byChoice.en: Medication access is now secured, addressing the nonadherence trigger for the admission.
byChoice.zh: 用药取得已经落实，解决了导致本次入院的服药中断诱因。

byChoice.en: Immediate support, home monitoring equipment, home nursing, and follow-up address the social and environmental barriers.
byChoice.zh: 近期支持、居家监测设备、居家护理和随访解决社会与环境障碍。

byChoice.en: Improved renal function, electrolytes, and resting oxygenation show clinical stability for the modified discharge plan.
byChoice.zh: 肾功能、电解质和静息氧合改善，说明修改后的出院计划下临床状态较稳定。

byChoice.en: BNP improvement is supportive, but BNP alone does not prove the client can manage medications, stairs, monitoring, or follow-up at home.
byChoice.zh: BNP 改善有支持意义，但 BNP 单独不能证明患者能在家管理用药、爬楼、监测或随访。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by matching each original problem to a verifiable resolution; do not clear discharge on a lab trend alone.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果时，要把每个原始问题对应到可验证的解决结果；不要仅凭一个实验室趋势就认为可以出院。

glossary.defZh: 判断干预后目标是否达到，并确认原先的问题是否已解决。
出院后已预约的复诊或联系，用于监测病情和调整治疗。
患者完成日常活动所需体力活动而不出现危险症状的能力。

correct.en: This case tests the difference between clinical improvement and discharge readiness. The patient is responding to diuresis, with improved weight, edema, JVD, and BNP, but Stage 1 shows unresolved discharge barriers: borderline resting respiratory status, exertional desaturation requiring oxygen recovery, failed teach-back, an unaffordable new diuretic that repeats the admission trigger, stairs/living alone/no scale, creatinine above baseline, and low-normal potassium during diuresis. The nurse should advocate to hold or modify the discharge order, document objective concerns, and mobilize case management, social work, pharmacy, home health, and family support. By Stage 3, discharge becomes appropriate only because each barrier has a concrete resolution and the client demonstrates functional tolerance, understanding, medication access, home support, follow-up, and stable clinical trajectory.
correct.zh: 本病例考查“临床改善”和“出院准备度”的区别。患者对利尿治疗有反应，体重、水肿、颈静脉怒张和 BNP 改善，但第 1 阶段仍显示未解决的出院障碍：静息呼吸状态临界、活动后低氧且需吸氧恢复、回授失败、新利尿剂负担不起并重现入院诱因、楼梯/独居/无体重秤、肌酐高于基线，以及利尿期间钾偏低正常。护士应倡导暂缓或修改出院医嘱，记录客观担忧，并启动个案管理、社工、药师、居家护理和家属支持。到第 3 阶段，只有在每个障碍都有具体解决结果，且患者证明有功能耐受、理解能力、用药取得、居家支持、随访和稳定临床趋势后，出院才合适。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not equate improving heart-failure markers with safe discharge. Ask: Can the client breathe and function in the home environment, understand the plan, obtain the medication, monitor symptoms/weight, and access support and follow-up?
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要把心衰指标改善等同于安全出院。要问：患者能否在居家环境中呼吸和活动、理解计划、取得药物、监测症状/体重，并获得支持和随访？

glossary.defZh: 患者在生理状态、功能能力、理解能力、用药取得、居家支持和随访安排方面均能安全离院的程度。
请患者用自己的话复述重点内容，以确认其是否真正理解教育内容。
当医嘱或计划可能危及患者安全且初次沟通未解决时，护士按机构政策逐级上报的流程。
护士在患者出院后到家中进行评估、用药指导、病情监测和护理支持的服务。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.en: Interprofessional conflict resolution: questionable potassium replacement order
title.zh: 跨专业冲突处理：有安全疑问的补钾医嘱

summary.en: A 71-year-old post-operative client with stage 3b chronic kidney disease has hypokalemia and receives an overnight potassium replacement order that conflicts with the unit electrolyte protocol.
summary.zh: 一名 71 岁术后患者合并 3b 期慢性肾病，出现低钾血症。夜间医生开出的补钾医嘱与病区电解质补充流程不一致。

title.zh: 1900 基线患者资料

content.en:
Background: 71-year-old woman on a medical-surgical unit, post-operative day 2 after open cholecystectomy complicated by bile leak requiring a surgical drain. History: hypertension, type 2 diabetes; stage 3b chronic kidney disease. Metformin is held perioperatively.
IV access/fluids: One 20-gauge peripheral IV in the left forearm; 0.9% normal saline infusing at 75 mL/hr. No central venous access.
Drain/diet: Surgical drain with about 200 mL bile-tinged output over the past 12 hr. Tolerating clear liquids; diet expected to advance tomorrow.
Unit electrolyte protocol: Before potassium replacement, verify most recent creatinine/eGFR. For peripheral IV potassium chloride, maximum concentration is 10 mEq per 100 mL and maximum rate is 10 mEq/hr. Central venous access is required for concentrations or rates above that threshold. Hold and clarify any potassium order that does not conform to protocol parameters.
1900 assessment: Alert and oriented; mild incisional soreness and fatigue; denies palpitations, muscle cramps, or weakness. T 37.1 C, HR 82 regular, BP 134/78, RR 16, SpO2 97% on room air. Cardiac monitor: normal sinus rhythm without ectopy. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, mildly tender near intact incision; drain functioning. Left forearm IV site without redness, swelling, tenderness, or infusion difficulty. No peripheral edema.
1600 labs: Na 138 mEq/L, K 3.1 mEq/L, Cl 101 mEq/L, HCO3 24 mEq/L, BUN 28 mg/dL, creatinine 1.6 mg/dL (baseline 1.3), eGFR 34 mL/min (baseline 42-44), Mg 1.9 mg/dL, phosphorus 3.4 mg/dL, glucose 142 mg/dL. CBC: WBC 9.2 ×10³/µL, Hgb 10.8 g/dL, platelets 188 ×10³/µL. POD1 potassium was 3.8 mEq/L and creatinine was 1.4 mg/dL.
content.zh:
背景：71 岁女性，住在内外科病区，开放胆囊切除术后第 2 天；术后发生胆漏并放置外科引流管。既往史：高血压、2 型糖尿病、3b 期慢性肾病。二甲双胍围手术期暂停。
静脉通路/输液：左前臂一条 20G 外周静脉通路；0.9% 生理盐水以 75 mL/hr 输注。无中心静脉通路。
引流/饮食：外科引流管 12 小时约 200 mL 胆汁样引流液。可耐受清流质，预计明天进阶饮食。
病区电解质流程：补钾前需核对最近的肌酐/eGFR。外周静脉给予氯化钾时，最高浓度为每 100 mL 10 mEq，最高速度为 10 mEq/hr。超过该浓度或速度必须使用中心静脉通路。任何不符合流程参数的补钾医嘱均需暂缓并澄清。
1900 评估：清醒、定向力正常；有轻度切口疼痛和疲乏；否认心悸、肌肉痉挛或无力。T 37.1 C，HR 82 次/分且规则，BP 134/78，RR 16，SpO2 97%（室内空气）。心电监护：正常窦性心律，无异位搏动。双肺清。腹部柔软，切口附近轻度压痛，切口钉完整；引流管通畅。左前臂 IV 部位无发红、肿胀、压痛或输注困难。无外周水肿。
1600 化验：Na 138 mEq/L，K 3.1 mEq/L，Cl 101 mEq/L，HCO3 24 mEq/L，BUN 28 mg/dL，肌酐 1.6 mg/dL（基线 1.3），eGFR 34 mL/min（基线 42-44），Mg 1.9 mg/dL，磷 3.4 mg/dL，葡萄糖 142 mg/dL。CBC：WBC 9.2 ×10³/µL，Hgb 10.8 g/dL，血小板 188 ×10³/µL。术后第 1 天血钾 3.8 mEq/L，肌酐 1.4 mg/dL。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段 - 1945 值班住院医回电
新医嘱与初始分歧

content.en: The covering resident returns the call and orders: potassium chloride 40 mEq in 100 mL normal saline IV, run over 1 hour through the peripheral line. The nurse notes that this exceeds the unit protocol for peripheral potassium concentration and rate and that the client's creatinine has risen with eGFR 34 mL/min. The nurse asks whether the dose can be split or the rate adjusted. The resident responds irritably: 'Her potassium is 3.1 - she needs it replaced. I've done this a hundred times. Just run it.' The resident does not address the renal function concern or the protocol discrepancy. The order has not been entered or administered.
content.zh: 值班住院医回电并下医嘱：氯化钾 40 mEq 加入 100 mL 生理盐水 IV，经外周静脉 1 小时输完。护士注意到该医嘱超过病区外周补钾的浓度和速度限制，且患者肌酐升高、eGFR 为 34 mL/min。护士询问是否可以分次给药或调整速度。住院医语气不耐烦地回答：‘她血钾 3.1，需要补钾。我做过一百次了，就这样输。’住院医未回应肾功能问题或流程不一致的问题。该医嘱尚未录入或执行。

title.zh: 第 2 阶段 - 2000 升级处理

title.en: Nurse response and chain of command
title.zh: 护士反应与指挥链

content.en: The nurse does not administer the potassium. She verifies the protocol and labs, notifies the charge nurse, and documents the communication, escalation, and outcome factually. She explains that the order exceeds the peripheral IV potassium protocol, the client has worsening renal function, and the resident dismissed the concern without a clinical rationale for overriding the protocol. The charge nurse agrees the order is outside protocol parameters and contacts the chief resident per chain-of-command policy. The client remains on the cardiac monitor: normal sinus rhythm without ectopy. Vital signs: HR 80, BP 130/76, RR 16, SpO2 97%. No new symptoms. Potassium has not been administered.
content.zh: 护士未给予该氯化钾。她核对流程和化验，通知 charge nurse，并客观记录沟通、升级处理和结果。她说明该医嘱超过外周静脉补钾流程，患者肾功能正在恶化，住院医未提供越过流程的临床理由就否定了护士的担忧。charge nurse 同意该医嘱超出流程参数，并按指挥链政策联系 chief resident。患者继续心电监护：正常窦性心律，无异位搏动。生命体征：HR 80，BP 130/76，RR 16，SpO2 97%。无新症状。尚未给予钾。

title.zh: 第 3 阶段 - 2030 修正医嘱与随访
处理结果与监测资料

content.en: The chief resident reviews the situation and enters a revised order: potassium chloride 10 mEq in 100 mL normal saline IV over 1 hour via the peripheral line, repeat for a total of four doses, with a serum potassium recheck after the second dose and a basic metabolic panel at 0600. The covering resident later calls back, acknowledges the protocol, and asks to be updated with the repeat result. The nurse administers the first dose at 2045. At 2245, after the second dose, a stat potassium drawn from the opposite arm returns at 3.4 mEq/L. The rhythm remains normal sinus without ectopy. The client denies IV site discomfort, palpitations, or muscle symptoms. The nurse continues the third dose per the revised order and documents the original order, protocol concern, escalation, revised order, doses administered, repeat potassium, and follow-up communication.
content.zh: chief resident 复核情况后下达修正医嘱：氯化钾 10 mEq 加入 100 mL 生理盐水，经外周静脉 1 小时输完，共重复 4 剂；第二剂后复查血钾，并于 0600 抽基本代谢面板。值班住院医随后回电，承认流程要求，并请护士告知复查结果。护士于 2045 给予第一剂。2245 第二剂后，从对侧手臂抽取的急查血钾为 3.4 mEq/L。心律仍为正常窦性心律，无异位搏动。患者否认 IV 部位不适、心悸或肌肉症状。护士按修正医嘱继续第三剂，并记录原始医嘱、流程担忧、升级处理、修正医嘱、已给剂量、复查血钾和后续沟通。

stem.en: Stage 1: Which findings are part of the safety concern with the potassium order as written? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第 1 阶段：关于当前补钾医嘱，哪些资料属于安全担忧的一部分？选择所有适用项。

options.en: The client asks when she can go home.
options.zh: 患者询问什么时候可以回家。

options.en: The cardiac monitor shows normal sinus rhythm without ectopy.
options.zh: 心电监护显示正常窦性心律，无异位搏动。

options.en: The creatinine is 1.6 mg/dL with eGFR 34 mL/min, worse than baseline.
options.zh: 肌酐 1.6 mg/dL、eGFR 34 mL/min，较基线恶化。

options.en: The order is potassium chloride 40 mEq IV over 1 hour.
options.zh: 医嘱为氯化钾 40 mEq IV 1 小时输完。

options.en: The order places 40 mEq potassium chloride in 100 mL normal saline.
options.zh: 医嘱将氯化钾 40 mEq 加入 100 mL 生理盐水。

options.en: The client has only a 20-gauge peripheral IV and no central venous access.
options.zh: 患者只有一条 20G 外周静脉通路，没有中心静脉通路。

correct.en: The unsafe pattern is the combination of excessive peripheral potassium rate, excessive concentration for the stated protocol, absence of central access, and worsened renal function. The client's stable rhythm and discharge question are real assessment findings, but they do not make the order safe or unsafe.
correct.zh: 不安全的组合包括：外周补钾速度过快、浓度超过本题给定流程、没有中心静脉通路，以及肾功能较基线恶化。患者心律稳定和询问出院是真实评估资料，但它们并不决定该医嘱是否安全。

byChoice.en: A 40 mEq/hr peripheral potassium rate exceeds the unit's stated 10 mEq/hr peripheral maximum, so this is a key safety cue.
byChoice.zh: 40 mEq/hr 的外周补钾速度超过本题病区规定的 10 mEq/hr 外周上限，因此是关键安全线索。

byChoice.en: A concentration of 40 mEq in 100 mL exceeds the stated peripheral concentration limit of 10 mEq per 100 mL.
byChoice.zh: 40 mEq/100 mL 超过题干给出的外周浓度上限 10 mEq/100 mL。

byChoice.en: A stable rhythm means the client is not currently showing ectopy, but it does not remove the risk of rapid or concentrated potassium infusion.
byChoice.zh: 心律稳定说明患者目前无异位搏动，但不能消除快速或高浓度补钾的风险。

byChoice.en: Worsening renal function increases the risk of potassium accumulation and iatrogenic hyperkalemia during aggressive replacement.
byChoice.zh: 肾功能恶化会增加补钾后钾潴留和医源性高钾血症风险。

byChoice.en: Only peripheral access is available, so an order requiring central-access-level concentration or rate cannot be carried out as written.
byChoice.zh: 患者只有外周通路，因此不能按原样执行需要中心静脉级别浓度或速度的医嘱。

byChoice.en: A discharge question is unrelated to the potassium order's rate, concentration, access route, or renal-clearance risk.
byChoice.zh: 询问出院与补钾医嘱的速度、浓度、通路或肾脏清除风险无关。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate the indication for therapy from the safety of the delivery method. A low potassium level explains why replacement is needed; it does not validate an unsafe route, rate, or concentration.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 把治疗适应证和给药方式安全性分开。低钾说明需要补钾，但不能证明不安全的通路、速度或浓度是合理的。

glossary.defZh: 用于纠正低钾血症的电解质补充药物；IV 给药需要严格控制浓度和速度。
估计肾脏滤过功能的指标，数值下降提示清除能力下降。
置入手或前臂等外周静脉的静脉通路，通常不能承受某些高浓度或快速输注。

stem.en: Stage 1: What is the best interpretation of the disagreement between the nurse and the covering resident?
stem.zh: 第 1 阶段：对护士和值班住院医之间分歧的最佳理解是什么？

options.en: A genuine patient-safety conflict based on a protocol discrepancy and renal-risk concern
options.zh: 基于流程不一致和肾功能风险的真实患者安全冲突

options.en: A clinical-preference difference where either potassium administration approach is equally acceptable
options.zh: 两种补钾方式都同样可接受的临床偏好差异

options.en: A scope-of-practice conflict because the nurse is trying to prescribe medication
options.zh: 护士试图开药，因此是执业范围冲突

options.en: A personality clash caused mainly by the resident's irritated tone
options.zh: 主要由住院医不耐烦语气导致的人际性格冲突

correct.en: The disagreement is driven by an objective safety issue: the order exceeds the stated peripheral potassium protocol and the client's renal function is worse than baseline. The resident's tone is a barrier, but it is not the root cause.
correct.zh: 该分歧的根源是客观安全问题：医嘱超过题干给出的外周补钾流程，并且患者肾功能较基线恶化。住院医的语气是沟通障碍，但不是根本原因。

byChoice.en: The nurse is not prescribing; the nurse is exercising the duty to question and hold an order that appears unsafe under facility protocol.
byChoice.zh: 护士不是在开药；护士是在履行对流程下疑似不安全医嘱进行质疑和暂缓执行的职责。

byChoice.en: The resident's irritation matters for communication, but focusing on tone alone would miss the medication-safety issue.
byChoice.zh: 住院医的不耐烦会影响沟通，但只关注语气会遗漏用药安全问题。

byChoice.en: This identifies the root cause: a concrete protocol violation plus a patient-specific risk factor that the provider has not addressed.
byChoice.zh: 这指出了根本原因：具体流程违规加上患者个体风险因素，而医生尚未回应。

byChoice.en: This is not an equal-preference situation because the case gives a clear facility protocol boundary for peripheral potassium administration.
byChoice.zh: 这不是同等偏好的情况，因为题干明确给出了外周补钾的机构流程界限。

testTakingStrategy.en: In conflict-resolution questions, identify whether the conflict has an objective safety anchor. A rude tone can distract you, but protocol violations and patient risk factors drive the nursing response.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到冲突处理题，先判断冲突是否有客观安全依据。语气不好可能干扰判断，但流程违规和患者风险因素才决定护士反应。

glossary.defZh: 围绕可能伤害患者的具体问题产生的跨专业分歧。
某一职业角色依法和按机构政策可以执行的职责范围。
医嘱或操作与机构既定流程不符。

stem.en: Stage 1: Which priority should guide the nurse's response to the resident's instruction to 'just run it'?
stem.zh: 第 1 阶段：住院医要求“就这样输”时，哪一优先原则应指导护士反应？

options.en: Preserve the working relationship by avoiding further challenge to the resident
options.zh: 为维持工作关系，避免继续质疑住院医

options.en: Protect the client from the unsafe rate and concentration while advocating for safe potassium replacement
options.zh: 保护患者免受不安全速度和浓度的风险，同时争取安全补钾方案

options.en: Refuse all potassium replacement until the attending evaluates the client in person
options.zh: 在主治医生亲自评估前拒绝所有补钾

options.en: Administer the order because potassium 3.1 mEq/L means replacement is urgent
options.zh: 因为血钾 3.1 mEq/L 需要紧急补钾，所以执行原医嘱

correct.en: The client needs potassium replacement, but the replacement must be delivered safely. The nurse's priority is not to choose between treatment and no treatment; it is to obtain a safe, protocol-consistent treatment plan.
correct.zh: 患者需要补钾，但补钾必须安全执行。护士的优先事项不是在治疗和不治疗之间二选一，而是取得安全、符合流程的治疗方案。

byChoice.en: The nurse should not abandon potassium replacement; the correct response is to pursue a safe revised order through appropriate escalation.
byChoice.zh: 护士不应放弃补钾；正确做法是通过适当升级争取安全的修正医嘱。

byChoice.en: Urgency to treat hypokalemia does not justify giving potassium at a rate and concentration that violate the stated protocol.
byChoice.zh: 需要治疗低钾并不意味着可以按违反流程的速度和浓度给钾。

byChoice.en: This keeps the focus on patient safety while still addressing the client's real hypokalemia.
byChoice.zh: 这既聚焦患者安全，也没有忽视患者真实存在的低钾血症。

byChoice.en: Collaboration matters, but hierarchy or comfort cannot take priority over an identified medication-safety concern.
byChoice.zh: 协作关系重要，但层级或人际舒适不能优先于已识别的用药安全问题。

testTakingStrategy.en: Avoid false dichotomies. NCLEX often tests whether you can say, 'Do the needed treatment safely,' instead of choosing unsafe treatment or no treatment.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 避免错误二分法。NCLEX 常考你能否选择“安全地完成需要的治疗”，而不是在不安全治疗和完全不治疗之间选择。

glossary.defZh: 护理和医疗决策中避免造成可预防伤害的伦理原则。
血清钾低于正常范围，可能影响肌肉和心脏电活动。
与机构安全参数一致的医嘱。

stem.en: Stage 2: Which nursing actions are appropriate to resolve this safety conflict? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段：为解决这一安全冲突，哪些护理措施是适当的？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Request a modified order or an authorized policy-consistent override through the appropriate pathway.
options.zh: 通过适当途径请求修正医嘱，或取得符合政策授权的例外处理。

options.en: Ask another nurse to hang the potassium so the assigned nurse is not the one administering it.
options.zh: 请另一名护士悬挂该钾剂，这样责任护士就不是执行者。

options.en: Withhold the potassium as written and escalate through the chain of command if the concern remains unresolved.
options.zh: 在问题未解决时暂缓按原医嘱补钾，并按指挥链升级处理。

options.en: Document the original order, concern, communications, escalation, and outcome factually.
options.zh: 客观记录原医嘱、担忧、沟通、升级处理和结果。

options.en: Administer the potassium as ordered because the provider has repeated the instruction.
options.zh: 因为医生重复了指示，所以按原医嘱给予氯化钾。

options.en: Use CUS or equivalent graded-assertiveness language to state that the order is a safety concern.
options.zh: 使用 CUS 或类似分级坚定沟通，说明该医嘱是安全问题。

correct.en: The correct pathway is graded assertive communication, pursuit of a safe revised or properly authorized order, withholding the unsafe order while escalating if needed, and factual documentation. Compliance or transferring the task to another nurse does not resolve the safety problem.
correct.zh: 正确路径包括分级坚定沟通、争取安全的修正医嘱或有授权的例外处理、必要时暂缓不安全医嘱并升级处理，以及客观记录。盲目执行或把任务转给另一名护士都不能解决安全问题。

byChoice.en: Structured language such as CUS makes the safety concern explicit and gives the provider a direct chance to respond.
byChoice.zh: CUS 等结构化语言能明确表达安全担忧，并给医生直接回应的机会。

byChoice.en: Delegating an unsafe order transfers risk to another nurse and the client; it does not make the order safe.
byChoice.zh: 把不安全医嘱转给另一名护士只是转移风险给同事和患者，并不能使医嘱安全。

byChoice.en: Holding the unsafe order while escalating protects the client and keeps the clinical need active rather than abandoned.
byChoice.zh: 在升级处理期间暂缓不安全医嘱可以保护患者，同时继续处理患者的临床需要。

byChoice.en: Repeating an unsafe instruction does not remove the nurse's accountability for administering a medication order that conflicts with protocol.
byChoice.zh: 医生重复不安全指示并不能免除护士执行违反流程医嘱的责任。

byChoice.en: Factual documentation records what was ordered, why it was questioned, who was notified, and what safe plan resulted.
byChoice.zh: 客观记录可说明原医嘱、质疑原因、通知对象，以及最终安全方案。

byChoice.en: A bedside nurse should not knowingly violate a stated facility protocol based only on pressure from the ordering provider; the order needs a safe revision or proper authorized pathway.
byChoice.zh: 床旁护士不应仅因开嘱者施压就明知违反机构流程；医嘱需要安全修正或通过正式授权途径处理。

testTakingStrategy.en: For unsafe orders, look for the complete safety loop: clear communication, hold/clarify, chain-of-command escalation, and documentation. Avoid answers that only protect the nurse or only obey hierarchy.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到不安全医嘱，寻找完整安全闭环：清楚沟通、暂缓/澄清、按指挥链升级、记录。避免只保护护士自己或只服从层级的选项。

glossary.defZh: 从明确表达担忧开始，必要时逐步加强安全表达并升级处理。
在特定情况下按机构政策允许偏离标准流程的正式授权。
记录客观事件、沟通内容、通知对象和结果，避免主观评价或指责。

stem.en: Stage 1: Immediately after the resident says, 'Just run it,' what is the nurse's best first action?
stem.zh: 第 1 阶段：住院医说“就这样输”后，护士最佳的第一步是什么？

options.en: End the call and immediately contact the chief resident without any further direct safety statement
options.zh: 结束通话并立即联系 chief resident，不再直接说明安全问题

options.en: Use CUS/two-challenge language to clearly state the protocol-based safety concern, then escalate if it is still not acknowledged
options.zh: 使用 CUS/两次挑战式沟通，清楚说明基于流程的安全担忧；若仍不被认可，再升级处理

options.en: Administer the potassium while notifying the charge nurse of the concern
options.zh: 一边按原医嘱给予氯化钾，一边通知 charge nurse

options.en: Document the disagreement and wait for the resident to call back later
options.zh: 记录分歧，然后等待住院医稍后回电

options.en: File an incident report before speaking with anyone else
options.zh: 在与任何人沟通前先填写事件报告

correct.en: The nurse has already tried a soft clarification. The next first action is a clear second challenge using CUS or equivalent language that identifies a safety issue. If that fails, chain-of-command escalation follows while the order remains withheld.
correct.zh: 护士已经进行了温和澄清。下一步应使用 CUS 或类似语言进行明确的第二次挑战，指出这是安全问题。若仍无效，则在暂缓医嘱的同时按指挥链升级。

byChoice.en: Waiting leaves the potassium need and the unsafe order unresolved.
byChoice.zh: 等待会让补钾需要和不安全医嘱都得不到解决。

byChoice.en: This is the best first action because it preserves direct communication while making the safety concern unmistakable.
byChoice.zh: 这是最佳第一步，因为它保留直接沟通，同时明确表达安全担忧。

byChoice.en: A safety report may be appropriate later per policy, but it does not replace immediate clinical communication and escalation.
byChoice.zh: 按政策之后可能需要安全事件报告，但它不能替代即时临床沟通和升级处理。

byChoice.en: Administering the potassium while escalating exposes the client to the very risk the nurse identified.
byChoice.zh: 一边执行一边升级会让患者暴露于护士已经识别出的风险。

byChoice.en: Escalation may become necessary, but skipping the clear safety statement bypasses graded assertiveness unless immediate danger prevents discussion.
byChoice.zh: 升级处理可能是必要的，但如果未因紧急危险而无法沟通，跳过明确安全陈述会绕过分级沟通。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a first clarification is dismissed, look for a stronger direct safety statement before escalation. But never choose an answer that administers the unsafe order while the concern remains unresolved.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当第一次澄清被否定时，先找更明确的直接安全陈述，然后再升级。但只要安全问题未解决，就不要选择执行不安全医嘱的答案。

glossary.defZh: 当安全担忧未被回应时，至少两次明确表达担忧并逐步升级。
用于机构安全追踪的内部报告；不能替代即时患者安全干预。
当直接沟通不能解决问题时，联系更高层级人员以解决安全风险。

stem.en: Stage 3: For each finding, indicate whether it supports that the conflict was resolved safely and professionally.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段：对于每项发现，判断它是否支持该冲突已被安全且专业地解决。

rows.en: The original 40 mEq/hr peripheral potassium order was not administered.
rows.zh: 原始 40 mEq/hr 外周补钾医嘱未被执行。

rows.en: A revised order gives 10 mEq in 100 mL over 1 hour via the peripheral line.
rows.zh: 修正医嘱为氯化钾 10 mEq/100 mL，经外周静脉 1 小时输完。

rows.en: Repeat potassium after two doses is 3.4 mEq/L and the rhythm remains normal sinus.
rows.zh: 两剂后复查血钾为 3.4 mEq/L，心律仍为正常窦性心律。

rows.en: The client denies IV site discomfort, palpitations, or muscle symptoms.
rows.zh: 患者否认 IV 部位不适、心悸或肌肉症状。

rows.en: The covering resident acknowledges the protocol and asks to receive the repeat result.
rows.zh: 值班住院医承认流程要求，并要求获知复查结果。

rows.en: The client had asked earlier when she could go home.
rows.zh: 患者早些时候询问什么时候可以回家。

correct.en: Adequate resolution requires both patient-safety outcomes and restored professional communication. The unsafe order was withheld, a protocol-consistent order was obtained, the potassium improved without adverse rhythm or IV-site findings, and the resident's follow-up communication became constructive. The earlier discharge question is unrelated to resolving the potassium-order conflict.
correct.zh: 充分解决需要同时评估患者安全结果和专业沟通是否恢复。不安全医嘱被暂缓，取得符合流程的医嘱，血钾改善且没有心律或 IV 部位不良表现，住院医后续沟通也变得建设性。早先的出院问题与补钾医嘱冲突的解决无关。

byChoice.en: Not administering the original unsafe order is a core patient-safety outcome.
byChoice.zh: 未执行原始不安全医嘱是核心患者安全结果。

byChoice.en: The revised order matches the stated peripheral protocol and resolves the order-safety problem.
byChoice.zh: 修正医嘱符合题干给出的外周流程，解决了医嘱安全问题。

byChoice.en: Improving potassium with stable rhythm shows the treatment is effective without evident cardiac complications.
byChoice.zh: 血钾改善且心律稳定，说明治疗有效且未见明显心脏并发症。

byChoice.en: Absence of IV-site discomfort and symptoms supports that the safer infusion is being tolerated.
byChoice.zh: 没有 IV 部位不适和相关症状，支持更安全的输注方式可耐受。

byChoice.en: Acknowledgment and constructive follow-up support restoration of the interprofessional communication channel.
byChoice.zh: 认可流程并进行建设性随访，支持跨专业沟通渠道得到修复。

byChoice.en: The discharge question is part of the client's general concerns, not evidence that the safety conflict was resolved.
byChoice.zh: 出院问题属于患者一般关切，不是安全冲突已解决的证据。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluation questions often require more than a lab improvement. Check whether the unsafe process was corrected, harm was avoided, and communication channels remain functional.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果题通常不只看化验改善。还要看不安全流程是否纠正、是否避免伤害，以及沟通渠道是否仍然有效。

glossary.defZh: 判断干预是否达到安全、临床和沟通目标的过程。
输注期间局部是否无疼痛、红肿、渗漏或静脉刺激表现。
以解决问题和继续合作为目标的专业沟通。

correct.en: This case centers on a protocol-based medication-safety conflict. The client truly needs potassium replacement, but the original order for 40 mEq in 100 mL over 1 hour through a peripheral IV conflicts with the stated unit protocol and is riskier because renal function is below baseline. The nurse first identifies the unsafe rate, concentration, access, and renal-function cues; uses assertive safety communication rather than treating the disagreement as a personality issue; withholds the unsafe order; escalates through the chain of command; and documents the facts. The outcome is adequate because the unsafe order is not carried out, a protocol-compliant replacement order is obtained, potassium improves without rhythm or IV-site complications, and follow-up communication with the resident is restored.
correct.zh: 本病例的核心是基于流程的用药安全冲突。患者确实需要补钾，但原始医嘱为经外周静脉 1 小时输注 40 mEq/100 mL 氯化钾，与病区流程不符；且患者肾功能低于基线，风险更高。护士首先识别不安全的速度、浓度、静脉通路和肾功能线索；使用明确的安全沟通，而不是把分歧当成人际矛盾；暂缓执行不安全医嘱；按指挥链升级处理；并如实记录。结果是充分的，因为不安全医嘱没有执行，取得了符合流程的补钾医嘱，血钾改善且没有心律或 IV 部位并发症，并且与住院医的后续沟通得到修复。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a provider order conflicts with a stated facility protocol, do not debate hierarchy. Identify the exact safety conflict, communicate it clearly, hold the unsafe action, and escalate until a safe plan exists.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当医生医嘱与已给出的机构流程冲突时，不要陷入层级问题。先找出具体安全冲突，清楚沟通，暂缓不安全操作，并升级处理直到有安全方案。

glossary.defZh: 一种分级表达安全担忧的方法：Concerned（担心）、Uncomfortable（不安）、Safety issue（安全问题）。
当直接沟通不能解决安全问题时，按机构流程向上一级人员逐级升级。
经外周静脉给予氯化钾；通常需要遵守较低的浓度和速度限制，以降低静脉刺激和快速补钾风险。
肾脏排出药物或电解质的能力；肾功能下降会增加钾潴留风险。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.en: Client advocacy for a capacitated older adult refusing PEG placement
title.zh: 为有决策能力且拒绝 PEG 置管的老年患者进行护理倡导

summary.en: An 82-year-old client with end-stage heart failure, progressive dysphagia, and poor oral intake refuses PEG tube placement after an informed discussion. Her adult children pressure the team to proceed, and her son claims authority under a DPOAHC that activates only if she loses decisional capacity.
summary.zh: 一名 82 岁患者患有终末期心力衰竭、进行性吞咽困难和进食不足。在充分知情沟通后，她拒绝放置 PEG 管。她的成年子女要求医疗团队继续置管，其儿子声称自己可根据医疗保健持久授权书（DPOAHC）作决定，但该授权仅在患者丧失决策能力时才生效。

title.zh: 入院记录

content.en:
Patient: Margaret Ellison, 82 years old.
Admitted from home with NYHA class IV heart-failure exacerbation, worsening dyspnea, edema, and poor oral intake for 5 days.
History: ischemic cardiomyopathy with EF 15%, CKD stage 4 with baseline creatinine 2.8 mg/dL, type 2 diabetes on basal insulin, progressive dysphagia followed by speech-language pathology for 6 months. Three hospitalizations in the past 4 months for fluid overload. Outpatient palliative-care referral was recently canceled by family.
Advance directive: son David is named durable power of attorney for health care, to be activated only if Mrs. Ellison loses decisional capacity.
Current orders: IV furosemide 40 mg every 12 hr, fluid restriction 1,200 mL/day, low-sodium cardiac diet with pureed foods and nectar-thick liquids per speech-language pathology, daily weights, telemetry.
Initial statement to admitting nurse: "I don't want any more tubes or machines. I've had a good life. I want to be comfortable."
Initial assessment: alert, conversational, oriented to person/place/time/situation. Mini-Cog 4/5. Mood calm and reflective; denies depression or hopelessness and states she feels "at peace." Vitals: T 36.8 C, HR 92 irregular, BP 104/62, RR 22, SpO2 93% on 2 L nasal cannula. Weight 68.4 kg; documented dry weight 64.2 kg. Bilateral lower-lung crackles, JVD at 45 degrees, 3+ bilateral pitting edema to mid-shin, temporal wasting. Oral mucosa moist. She can manage small sips of nectar-thick water but needs prolonged time to initiate swallowing.
Admission labs: BNP 2,840 pg/mL, Na 131 mEq/L, K 5.1 mEq/L, BUN 48 mg/dL, creatinine 3.2 mg/dL, eGFR 14 mL/min/1.73 m2, glucose 142 mg/dL, albumin 2.6 g/dL, Hgb 9.8 g/dL, WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL, platelets 188 ×10³/µL, INR 1.1, prealbumin 11 mg/dL.
content.zh:
患者：Margaret Ellison，82 岁。
因 NYHA IV 级心力衰竭加重从家中入院，过去 5 天出现气促加重、水肿和进食不足。
病史：缺血性心肌病，射血分数 15%；慢性肾病 4 期，基线肌酐 2.8 mg/dL；2 型糖尿病，使用基础胰岛素；进行性吞咽困难，过去 6 个月由言语语言病理科随访。过去 4 个月因液体负荷过多住院 3 次。近期曾转诊门诊姑息治疗，但被家属取消。
预立医疗指示：儿子 David 被指定为医疗保健持久授权代理人，但只有在 Ellison 太太丧失决策能力时才生效。
现有医嘱：呋塞米 40 mg IV 每 12 小时一次；限液 1,200 mL/日；低钠心脏饮食，按言语语言病理科建议给予糊状食物和花蜜稠液；每日体重；遥测监护。
入院时对护士的表述：“我不想再要任何管子或机器了。我这一生过得很好。我想舒服一点。”
初始评估：清醒、能交谈，人物、地点、时间和情境定向力均正常。Mini-Cog 4/5。情绪平静、能反思；否认抑郁或绝望，并表示自己“很平静”。生命体征：T 36.8 C，HR 92 次/分且不规则，BP 104/62，RR 22 次/分，SpO2 93%，经鼻导管吸氧 2 L/min。体重 68.4 kg；记录的干体重 64.2 kg。双下肺湿啰音，45 度可见颈静脉怒张，双下肢至小腿中段 3+ 凹陷性水肿，颞部消瘦。口腔黏膜湿润。可少量饮用花蜜稠水，但启动吞咽时间延长。
入院实验室：BNP 2,840 pg/mL，Na 131 mEq/L，K 5.1 mEq/L，BUN 48 mg/dL，肌酐 3.2 mg/dL，eGFR 14 mL/min/1.73 m2，血糖 142 mg/dL，白蛋白 2.6 g/dL，Hgb 9.8 g/dL，WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL，血小板 188 ×10³/µL，INR 1.1，前白蛋白 11 mg/dL。

title.zh: 阶段 1：住院第 1 天下午
PEG 沟通及家属反应

content.en:
The attending physician discusses progressive dysphagia and poor nutritional status with the family and recommends PEG tube placement to maintain nutrition and hydration. Mrs. Ellison listens to the explanation and asks, "Will the tube cure my heart?" and "Will I still be able to eat anything by mouth?" She then states, "I understand what you're telling me. I don't want a feeding tube. I want to eat what I can and be comfortable."
Physician documentation: "Patient demonstrates understanding of risks and benefits of PEG placement, including that PEG does not necessarily eliminate aspiration risk, and continued weight loss without it. She articulates her values and reasoning clearly. Decision-making capacity intact. Patient declines PEG at this time."
Son David tells the nurse: "She doesn't know what she's saying. She's old and she's giving up. You need to talk some sense into her. I'm her power of attorney — I want the tube placed." Daughter Karen calls and says, "My brother and I agree. We want everything done. She's just scared. Can't you convince her?" The nurse confirms that the advance directive activates the son's authority only if Mrs. Ellison loses decisional capacity.
Vitals: HR 88, BP 108/64, RR 20, SpO2 94% on 2 L. Weight 67.8 kg. She is resting comfortably, tolerating small amounts of pureed food and nectar-thick liquids. Telemetry: atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular rate.
content.zh:
主治医师与家属讨论患者进行性吞咽困难和营养状况不佳，并建议放置 PEG 管以维持营养和水分。Ellison 太太听完解释后问：“这个管子能治好我的心脏吗？”以及“我以后还能不能吃一点东西？”随后她说：“我理解你们说的内容。我不想要喂食管。我想吃多少算多少，并且舒服一点。”
医师记录：“患者表现出理解 PEG 置管风险与获益的能力，包括 PEG 不一定能消除误吸风险，以及不置管可能继续体重下降。她能清楚表达自己的价值观和理由。决策能力完整。患者此时拒绝 PEG。”
儿子 David 对护士说：“她不知道自己在说什么。她老了，只是在放弃。你们要劝醒她。我是她的授权代理人——我要放这个管子。” 女儿 Karen 打电话到病区说：“我和我哥哥意见一致。我们希望什么都做。她只是害怕。你不能说服她吗？” 护士确认预立医疗指示规定：只有在 Ellison 太太丧失决策能力时，儿子的代理权才生效。
生命体征：HR 88 次/分，BP 108/64，RR 20 次/分，SpO2 94%，吸氧 2 L/min。体重 67.8 kg。患者安静休息，可少量耐受糊状食物和花蜜稠液。遥测：心房颤动，心室率受控。

title.zh: 阶段 2：住院第 2 天上午
再次拒绝及医师建议

content.en:
David again tells the attending physician that nobody is listening to the family. The physician privately tells the nurse, "The family is really upset. Maybe we should just schedule the PEG consult and see if she changes her mind once GI comes by. It might calm things down."
The nurse reassesses Mrs. Ellison. She remains alert, oriented, calm, and states without prompting: "I told the doctor yesterday. No tube. I want to go home and be comfortable. I've thought about this for months — this isn't a snap decision." She adds, "My children mean well, but this is my body and my life." When asked about pressure or coercion, she states, "David keeps coming in and telling me I'm being selfish. It upsets me, but it doesn't change my mind." She asks the nurse, "Will you make sure they respect what I want?"
Vitals: HR 90, BP 100/60, RR 20, SpO2 94% on 2 L. Weight 67.2 kg. She ate about 30% of pureed breakfast. BNP 2,410 pg/mL, creatinine 3.4 mg/dL, K 5.3 mEq/L, Na 130 mEq/L.
content.zh:
David 再次告诉主治医师，认为没有人听家属意见。医师私下对护士说：“家属真的很不高兴。也许我们可以先安排 PEG 会诊，等胃肠科来看后再看看她会不会改变主意。这样可能能让事情平静下来。”
护士重新评估 Ellison 太太。她仍然清醒、定向力正常、情绪平静，并主动说：“我昨天已经告诉医生了。不要管子。我想回家，舒服一点。这件事我已经想了好几个月——不是一时冲动的决定。” 她又说：“我的孩子们是好意，但这是我的身体、我的人生。” 护士询问她是否受到压力或胁迫，她说：“David 一直进来，说我自私。这让我难过，但不会改变我的想法。” 她问护士：“你能确保他们尊重我的意愿吗？”
生命体征：HR 90 次/分，BP 100/60，RR 20 次/分，SpO2 94%，吸氧 2 L/min。体重 67.2 kg。糊状早餐约吃了 30%。BNP 2,410 pg/mL，肌酐 3.4 mg/dL，K 5.3 mEq/L，Na 130 mEq/L。

title.zh: 阶段 3：住院第 2 天傍晚
护理倡导措施及姑息治疗评估

content.en:
The nurse has documented Mrs. Ellison's repeated, consistent refusal with direct quotes and capacity observations; informed the charge nurse of the ethical concern; requested palliative care; and arranged a family meeting for the next morning with the attending physician, palliative care team, social worker, and both adult children. David states he has contacted a lawyer and "will get a court order" to have the PEG placed.
Mrs. Ellison is resting and tells the nurse she is glad someone is listening to her. She asks about hospice options at home. Vitals: HR 86, BP 102/58, RR 18, SpO2 95% on 2 L. Weight 66.8 kg. She tolerated small amounts of pureed lunch. Telemetry unchanged.
Palliative-care nurse practitioner note: "Mrs. Ellison demonstrates intact decisional capacity, consistent values-based reasoning, and an informed, voluntary refusal of PEG tube placement. Recommend goals-of-care meeting with family, comfort-focused plan of care, and hospice referral per patient's expressed wishes."
content.zh:
护士已在护理记录中记录 Ellison 太太反复且一致的拒绝，包括直接引语和决策能力相关观察；已告知护士长存在伦理问题；已申请姑息治疗；并安排次日上午由主治医师、姑息治疗团队、社工和两名成年子女参加家庭会议。David 表示他已联系律师，并“会拿到法院命令”要求放置 PEG。
Ellison 太太正在休息，并告诉护士，很高兴有人在听她说话。她询问在家接受临终关怀的选择。生命体征：HR 86 次/分，BP 102/58，RR 18 次/分，SpO2 95%，吸氧 2 L/min。体重 66.8 kg。午餐少量糊状食物可耐受。遥测无变化。
姑息治疗护士执业者记录：“Ellison 太太表现出完整的决策能力，基于一致价值观进行推理，并对 PEG 置管作出知情、自愿的拒绝。建议与家属进行照护目标会议，制定以舒适为重点的照护计划，并根据患者明确表达的意愿转介临终关怀。”

stem.en: Stage 1: Highlight the findings that establish that Mrs. Ellison's refusal is the governing decision.
stem.zh: 阶段 1：请标出哪些发现能确立 Ellison 太太的拒绝是当前应遵循的决定。

segments.en: Chart review findings:
segments.zh: 病历审查发现：

segments.en: The physician documents that Mrs. Ellison understands the risks and benefits of PEG placement, including continued weight loss without it.
segments.zh: 医师记录 Ellison 太太理解 PEG 置管的风险与获益，包括不置管可能继续体重下降。

segments.en: She asks clarifying questions about whether the tube will cure her heart failure and whether she may still eat by mouth.
segments.zh: 她提出澄清性问题，询问管子是否能治愈心力衰竭，以及是否仍可经口进食。

segments.en: She states, "I understand what you're telling me. I don't want a feeding tube. I want to eat what I can and be comfortable."
segments.zh: 她说：“我理解你们说的内容。我不想要喂食管。我想吃多少算多少，并且舒服一点。”

segments.en: The advance directive states that the son's DPOAHC authority activates only if Mrs. Ellison loses decisional capacity.
segments.zh: 预立医疗指示说明，儿子的 DPOAHC 权限只有在 Ellison 太太丧失决策能力时才生效。

segments.en: Mini-Cog score is 4/5 with a normal clock draw.
segments.zh: Mini-Cog 得分为 4/5，画钟正常。

segments.en: David says he is the power of attorney and wants the tube placed.
segments.zh: David 说自己是授权代理人，并要求放置管子。

segments.en: Albumin is 2.6 g/dL and prealbumin is 11 mg/dL.
segments.zh: 白蛋白 2.6 g/dL，前白蛋白 11 mg/dL。

segments.en: Speech-language pathology has followed progressive dysphagia for 6 months.
segments.zh: 言语语言病理科已随访进行性吞咽困难 6 个月。

correct.en: The governing cues are decision-specific capacity documentation, Mrs. Ellison's demonstrated understanding and clarifying questions, her clear values-based refusal, and the advance directive clause showing that the son's surrogate authority is dormant while she has capacity.
correct.zh: 关键线索是：针对 PEG 决定的能力评估记录、患者表现出理解并提出澄清问题、她清楚且基于价值观地拒绝，以及预立医疗指示说明只要她仍有能力，儿子的代理权就尚未生效。

byChoice.en: This directly supports decision-specific capacity because it documents understanding of risks and benefits.
byChoice.zh: 这直接支持针对该决定的决策能力，因为记录了她理解风险与获益。

byChoice.en: Clarifying questions show that she is engaging with the information rather than passively refusing.
byChoice.zh: 提出澄清问题说明她在主动理解信息，而不是被动拒绝。

byChoice.en: This is the patient's own informed, values-based refusal, which governs while she has capacity.
byChoice.zh: 这是患者本人知情且基于价值观的拒绝；只要她有能力，该决定就应被遵循。

byChoice.en: The activation clause shows that the son does not currently have decision-making authority.
byChoice.zh: 生效条件说明儿子目前没有代替患者作决定的权力。

byChoice.en: A normal cognitive screen supports the absence of an obvious red flag, but it does not by itself establish legal decision-making authority for this PEG decision.
byChoice.zh: 认知筛查正常可提示没有明显认知警讯，但不能单独确立患者对 PEG 决定的法律决策能力。

byChoice.en: The son's claim is a cue to check the document, not proof that his authority has activated.
byChoice.zh: 儿子的说法提示护士应核对文件，但不能证明他的代理权已经生效。

byChoice.en: These nutritional labs support why PEG is being recommended; they do not determine who has consent authority.
byChoice.zh: 这些营养指标支持为什么会建议 PEG，但不能决定谁有同意或拒绝的权力。

byChoice.en: Dysphagia supports the clinical rationale for discussing PEG but does not override a capacitated refusal.
byChoice.zh: 吞咽困难支持讨论 PEG 的医学理由，但不能推翻有决策能力患者的拒绝。

testTakingStrategy.en: For capacity and consent questions, key the findings that show understanding, reasoning, voluntariness, and who legally holds authority now—not the findings that make the proposed treatment medically reasonable.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到决策能力和同意权题目时，优先寻找能证明理解、推理、自愿性以及当前谁有法律权力的线索，而不是只看治疗在医学上是否合理。

glossary.defZh: 针对某一项具体治疗决定评估患者是否能理解、权衡并表达选择。
患者无能力时由指定代理人代替作医疗决定的权力。
某项治疗在医学上可考虑或建议的理由。

stem.en: Stage 1: David insists that his DPOAHC status allows him to override his mother's refusal and request PEG placement. Whose decision governs at this time?
stem.zh: 阶段 1：David 坚称自己的 DPOAHC 身份允许他推翻母亲的拒绝并要求放置 PEG。此时应遵循谁的决定？

options.en: The decision should be delayed until Mrs. Ellison's daughter can be physically present.
options.zh: 应推迟决定，直到 Ellison 太太的女儿能亲自到场。

options.en: Mrs. Ellison's refusal governs because her decision-making capacity is intact and documented.
options.zh: 应遵循 Ellison 太太的拒绝，因为她的决策能力完整且已有记录。

options.en: David's decision governs because a DPOAHC always has priority over the patient's current choice.
options.zh: 应遵循 David 的决定，因为 DPOAHC 总是优先于患者当前选择。

options.en: The physician may proceed because PEG placement is medically recommended for poor intake and dysphagia.
options.zh: 医师可以继续安排，因为 PEG 对进食不足和吞咽困难有医学建议理由。

options.en: The children should decide together because both adult children agree with PEG placement.
options.zh: 应由两名成年子女共同决定，因为他们都同意 PEG 置管。

correct.en: A capacitated adult holds the authority to accept or refuse treatment. The DPOAHC is meaningful but dormant because the activation condition—loss of decisional capacity—has not occurred.
correct.zh: 有决策能力的成年人有权接受或拒绝治疗。DPOAHC 文件本身有法律意义，但由于触发生效条件——丧失决策能力——尚未发生，因此目前尚未生效。

byChoice.en: A DPOAHC does not override the current decision of a capacitated patient.
byChoice.zh: DPOAHC 不能推翻有决策能力患者当前作出的决定。

byChoice.en: This correctly applies autonomy and the documented capacity assessment.
byChoice.zh: 这正确应用了自主原则和已记录的决策能力评估。

byChoice.en: Waiting for the daughter is unnecessary because the patient has already made an informed decision and can speak for herself.
byChoice.zh: 无需等待女儿到场，因为患者已作出知情决定，并能为自己表达意愿。

byChoice.en: Family agreement does not create authority over a capacitated adult's treatment refusal.
byChoice.zh: 家属意见一致并不会赋予他们推翻有能力成年患者拒绝治疗的权力。

byChoice.en: Medical recommendation is not a substitute for consent when the patient has capacity.
byChoice.zh: 当患者有决策能力时，医学建议不能替代患者同意。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not let the phrase 'power of attorney' automatically shift authority away from a patient. Ask whether the patient currently lacks capacity and whether the document is activated.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要因为看到“授权代理人”就自动把决定权从患者身上转移。先判断患者当前是否无能力，以及文件是否已经生效。

glossary.defZh: 患者根据自己的价值观作医疗决定的权利。
指定医疗代理人的文件，通常在患者无能力时才用于代理决策。
满足文件规定条件后，代理人才开始具有决策权限。

stem.en: Stage 2: The physician suggests scheduling the PEG consult anyway to calm the family. What is the nurse's priority ethical obligation?
stem.zh: 阶段 2：医师建议仍先安排 PEG 会诊以安抚家属。护士最优先的伦理职责是什么？

options.en: Advocate for Mrs. Ellison's informed, voluntary refusal so it is not overridden by family pressure or provider ambivalence.
options.zh: 为 Ellison 太太知情、自愿的拒绝进行倡导，防止其意愿被家属压力或医师摇摆态度覆盖。

options.en: Prioritize correcting malnutrition because albumin and prealbumin are low.
options.zh: 优先纠正营养不良，因为白蛋白和前白蛋白偏低。

options.en: Schedule the consult because allowing GI to speak with her is a neutral way to keep the family calm.
options.zh: 安排会诊，因为让胃肠科与她谈谈是一种中立方式，也能让家属平静。

options.en: Tell the family the nurse cannot discuss the situation and avoid further contact with them.
options.zh: 告诉家属护士不能讨论此事，并避免继续接触他们。

options.en: Stay neutral and let the physician and family resolve the disagreement without nursing involvement.
options.zh: 保持中立，让医师和家属自行解决分歧，护士不介入。

correct.en: The immediate ethical risk is that the patient's autonomous refusal may be undermined. Nursing advocacy means protecting the patient's voice, while still addressing family distress through appropriate interdisciplinary support.
correct.zh: 当前最直接的伦理风险是患者自主拒绝可能被削弱。护理倡导意味着保护患者的声音，同时通过合适的跨专业支持处理家属痛苦。

byChoice.en: The family deserves compassionate communication and support; avoidance does not protect the patient or resolve the conflict.
byChoice.zh: 家属仍需要同理沟通和支持；回避既不能保护患者，也不能解决冲突。

byChoice.en: Nursing neutrality in the face of an autonomy threat becomes a failure to advocate.
byChoice.zh: 当患者自主权受到威胁时，护士所谓“中立”会变成未履行倡导职责。

byChoice.en: This centers the capacitated patient's right to refuse treatment and addresses the actual threat in Stage 2.
byChoice.zh: 这把有能力患者拒绝治疗的权利放在中心，并回应了阶段 2 的真正威胁。

byChoice.en: A consult requested as a pressure tactic after refusal is not neutral; it may undermine autonomy.
byChoice.zh: 患者已拒绝后，为施压或安抚家属而安排会诊并不中立，可能削弱自主权。

byChoice.en: The nutritional problem is real, but a clinical problem does not override informed refusal.
byChoice.zh: 营养问题确实存在，但临床问题不能推翻知情拒绝。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several concerns compete, identify what is being threatened right now. Here, the threat is not malnutrition alone; it is loss of the patient's autonomous choice.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个问题竞争优先级时，要找出当前正在受威胁的是什么。本题中受威胁的不只是营养状态，而是患者自主选择权。

glossary.defZh: 专业人员根据伦理原则必须承担的责任。
通过压力、威胁或操控影响患者决定。
医务人员在明确原则或计划上犹豫不定，可能影响患者权利保护。

stem.en: Stage 2: Which nursing actions are appropriate to uphold Mrs. Ellison's wishes and address the family conflict? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段 2：哪些护理措施适合用于维护 Ellison 太太的意愿并处理家属冲突？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Communicate directly with the physician that scheduling a PEG consult over the documented refusal raises an ethical concern.
options.zh: 直接与医师沟通：在已有拒绝记录的情况下安排 PEG 会诊存在伦理问题。

options.en: Confirm with Mrs. Ellison that her decision remains informed and voluntary and assess whether pressure has affected her choice.
options.zh: 与 Ellison 太太确认其决定仍是知情且自愿的，并评估压力是否影响了她的选择。

options.en: Encourage Mrs. Ellison to meet with GI and reconsider PEG placement for her family's sake.
options.zh: 鼓励 Ellison 太太为了家属而见胃肠科医师并重新考虑 PEG 置管。

options.en: Document her repeated refusal with direct quotes and nursing observations of alertness, orientation, calm affect, and values-based reasoning.
options.zh: 记录她反复拒绝的内容，包括直接引语，以及护士观察到的清醒、定向力正常、情绪平静和基于价值观的推理。

options.en: Defer to David's demand because he holds the DPOAHC document and is threatening escalation.
options.zh: 因为 David 持有 DPOAHC 文件且威胁升级，所以听从他的要求。

options.en: Request palliative-care/social-work support and help arrange a structured family meeting with Mrs. Ellison's consent and participation as she desires.
options.zh: 申请姑息治疗和社工支持，并在 Ellison 太太同意且愿意参与的情况下协助安排结构化家庭会议。

correct.en: Appropriate advocacy is coordinated: reassess voluntariness, document clearly, address the physician's plan directly, and bring in palliative care, social work, and a family meeting to support goals-of-care clarification without pressuring the patient.
correct.zh: 适当的倡导是多方面协调进行的：重新评估自愿性，清楚记录，直接处理医师拟安排会诊的问题，并引入姑息治疗、社工和家庭会议，在不施压患者的前提下澄清照护目标。

byChoice.en: The DPOAHC is not activated while the patient has capacity; legal threats do not transfer authority to the son.
byChoice.zh: 患者有能力时 DPOAHC 尚未生效；法律威胁不会把决定权转移给儿子。

byChoice.en: Clear documentation protects the patient's stated wishes and creates an accurate record of capacity-related observations.
byChoice.zh: 清楚记录可保护患者明确表达的意愿，并准确记录与能力相关的观察。

byChoice.en: Interdisciplinary support helps address family distress while keeping the patient's goals central.
byChoice.zh: 跨专业支持有助于处理家属痛苦，同时保持患者目标居于中心。

byChoice.en: Direct communication addresses the immediate risk that the consult may be placed despite refusal.
byChoice.zh: 直接沟通可处理会诊可能在患者拒绝后仍被安排的即时风险。

byChoice.en: Ongoing assessment of voluntariness is appropriate because family pressure is present.
byChoice.zh: 由于存在家属压力，持续评估决定是否自愿是适当的。

byChoice.en: This turns the nurse into an agent of family pressure and undermines the patient's autonomy.
byChoice.zh: 这会让护士变成家属压力的执行者，并削弱患者自主权。

testTakingStrategy.en: For SATA advocacy items, select actions that protect the patient, create a record, communicate up the chain, and use team resources. Eliminate actions that persuade, pressure, or defer to the wrong decision-maker.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做多选倡导题时，选择能保护患者、形成记录、向上沟通并使用团队资源的措施。排除劝说、施压或把决定权交给错误对象的措施。

glossary.defZh: 对患者陈述、评估和护理行动的客观、及时记录。
着重缓解症状、明确照护目标并提升生活质量的跨专业照护。
由跨专业团队与患者和家属沟通病情、目标和计划的结构化会议。

stem.en: Stage 2: After reassessing Mrs. Ellison and confirming that she remains alert, informed, voluntary, and consistent in refusing PEG placement, what is the nurse's first advocacy action?
stem.zh: 阶段 2：护士重新评估 Ellison 太太，并确认她仍然清醒、知情、自愿且一致地拒绝 PEG 置管后，第一项倡导行动应是什么？

options.en: Finish documenting the refusal first and wait to speak with the physician after the family meeting is arranged.
options.zh: 先完成拒绝记录，等家庭会议安排好后再与医师沟通。

options.en: Ask David to bring the DPOAHC paperwork to the unit before taking further action.
options.zh: 先请 David 把 DPOAHC 文件带到病区，再采取进一步行动。

options.en: Respectfully tell the physician without delay that Mrs. Ellison again declined PEG placement, capacity is documented, and scheduling the consult over refusal raises an ethical concern.
options.zh: 立即且尊重地告知医师：Ellison 太太再次拒绝 PEG，决策能力已有记录，在其拒绝后仍安排会诊存在伦理问题。

options.en: Call the ethics committee first before addressing the concern with the physician.
options.zh: 先联系伦理委员会，再与医师处理此问题。

options.en: Ask Mrs. Ellison whether she will agree to a one-time GI consult so the family can feel reassured.
options.zh: 询问 Ellison 太太是否愿意接受一次胃肠科会诊，好让家属安心。

correct.en: The physician's proposed consult is the proximate threat to autonomy. The nurse should use clear structured communication to stop the consult from being placed over the patient's refusal and recommend palliative care and a family meeting instead.
correct.zh: 医师拟安排会诊是当前最直接威胁患者自主权的因素。护士应使用清楚、有结构的沟通，防止在患者拒绝后仍安排会诊，并建议转向姑息治疗和家庭会议。

byChoice.en: Reintroducing the consult to reassure the family can become coercive after the patient has clearly refused.
byChoice.zh: 患者明确拒绝后，为安抚家属再次提出会诊可能形成胁迫。

byChoice.en: The chart already states the DPOAHC activation condition, and waiting on paperwork delays advocacy.
byChoice.zh: 病历已说明 DPOAHC 的生效条件；等待文件会延误倡导。

byChoice.en: Documentation is necessary but does not stop the consult from being placed now.
byChoice.zh: 记录是必要的，但不能阻止会诊现在被安排。

byChoice.en: Ethics consultation may be appropriate if conflict persists, but direct provider communication comes first for the immediate issue.
byChoice.zh: 若冲突持续，伦理会诊可能合适；但对于当前即时问题，应先直接与医师沟通。

byChoice.en: This directly addresses the immediate risk and stays within the nurse's advocacy role.
byChoice.zh: 这直接处理当前风险，并符合护士的倡导职责范围。

testTakingStrategy.en: For 'first action' questions, choose the step that addresses the most immediate threat. Here, the consult order is the immediate threat, so direct provider communication comes before slower support processes.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做“第一步行动”题时，选择能处理最即时威胁的步骤。本题中会诊医嘱是即时威胁，因此应先直接与医师沟通，再进行较慢的支持流程。

glossary.defZh: 一种结构化沟通方式：情况、背景、评估、建议。
由伦理团队协助处理医疗决策冲突或价值冲突的过程。
当前最可能立即造成伤害或权利受损的问题。

stem.en: Stage 3: For each finding, indicate whether it shows effective advocacy for Mrs. Ellison's autonomous refusal.
stem.zh: 阶段 3：请判断每项发现是否表明对 Ellison 太太自主拒绝的护理倡导有效。

rows.en: Nursing notes and the palliative-care assessment consistently document her capacity, values-based reasoning, and refusal.
rows.zh: 护理记录和姑息治疗评估均一致记录她有决策能力、基于价值观推理并拒绝 PEG。

rows.en: No PEG consult has been placed over the patient's refusal.
rows.zh: 未在患者拒绝后仍安排 PEG 会诊。

rows.en: A comfort-focused plan and hospice referral are being developed according to her expressed wishes.
rows.zh: 正在根据她表达的意愿制定以舒适为重点的计划并转介临终关怀。

rows.en: Mrs. Ellison says she is glad someone is listening and asks about hospice options at home.
rows.zh: Ellison 太太说很高兴有人在听她说话，并询问在家接受临终关怀的选择。

rows.en: David threatens legal action to obtain a PEG tube placement.
rows.zh: David 威胁采取法律行动以要求放置 PEG 管。

rows.en: The admission albumin and prealbumin values were low.
rows.zh: 入院时白蛋白和前白蛋白数值偏低。

correct.en: Effective advocacy is shown by documentation, alignment of the plan with the patient's goals, absence of an unauthorized PEG consult, and the patient's perception that her voice is being heard. Ongoing family distress and nutritional lab abnormalities may still exist, but they do not mean advocacy has failed.
correct.zh: 倡导有效的证据包括：记录一致、照护计划符合患者目标、未安排未经同意的 PEG 会诊，以及患者感到自己的声音被听见。家属痛苦和营养实验室异常可能仍然存在，但这并不代表倡导失败。

byChoice.en: Consistent documentation protects her decision across the care team.
byChoice.zh: 一致记录有助于整个照护团队持续保护她的决定。

byChoice.en: Not placing the consult over refusal shows the immediate autonomy threat has been contained.
byChoice.zh: 未在拒绝后仍安排会诊，说明即时的自主权威胁已被控制。

byChoice.en: A comfort-focused plan and hospice referral align care with the patient's expressed goals.
byChoice.zh: 以舒适为重点的计划和临终关怀转介符合患者表达的目标。

byChoice.en: The patient's sense of being heard is a meaningful outcome of advocacy.
byChoice.zh: 患者感到被倾听是护理倡导的重要结果。

byChoice.en: A legal threat reflects ongoing family distress, not failure of the nurse's advocacy.
byChoice.zh: 法律威胁反映家属仍有痛苦和冲突，并不代表护士倡导失败。

byChoice.en: Admission nutritional labs describe clinical status and prognosis; they do not measure whether autonomy is being protected.
byChoice.zh: 入院营养指标反映临床状态和预后，但不衡量患者自主权是否被保护。

testTakingStrategy.en: Outcome evaluation should match the goal of the intervention. The goal was not to make everyone agree or normalize labs; it was to protect the patient's informed refusal.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果要与干预目标一致。本题目标不是让所有人都同意，也不是让实验室指标正常，而是保护患者的知情拒绝。

glossary.defZh: 判断护理措施是否达到预期目标的过程。
将症状缓解、生活质量和患者目标置于中心的照护方式。
为预期寿命有限且选择舒适照护的患者提供的支持性服务。

correct.en: This case centers on protecting a capacitated adult's informed refusal when family pressure and provider ambivalence threaten to override it. The decisive cues are the documented decision-specific capacity assessment, Mrs. Ellison's repeated values-based refusal, absence of coercion changing her decision, and an advance directive that gives the son surrogate authority only if capacity is lost. Appropriate nursing advocacy includes direct communication with the physician, careful documentation, palliative-care and social-work involvement, a structured family meeting, and escalation to ethics or risk management if needed. Effective advocacy is measured by whether the plan of care honors the patient's stated goals and whether she feels heard, not by whether the family agrees.
correct.zh: 本病例的核心是在家属压力和医师态度摇摆可能覆盖患者意愿时，保护有决策能力成人的知情拒绝权。关键线索包括：已记录的针对该决定的决策能力评估、Ellison 太太反复且基于价值观的拒绝、没有胁迫改变其决定，以及预立医疗指示明确儿子只有在她丧失能力时才具有代理权。适当的护理倡导包括直接与医师沟通、仔细记录、介入姑息治疗和社工、安排结构化家庭会议，并在需要时升级至伦理委员会或风险管理。倡导是否有效，应看照护计划是否尊重患者目标、患者是否感到被倾听，而不是看家属是否满意。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate medical indication from consent authority. A treatment can be clinically reasonable and still cannot proceed when a capacitated client refuses it.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 要区分“医学上有理由建议治疗”和“谁有权同意治疗”。某项治疗即使在医学上合理，只要有决策能力的患者拒绝，就不能强行进行。

glossary.defZh: 护士主动保护患者权利、意愿和安全，尤其是在患者声音可能被忽视时。
患者理解信息、权衡风险获益、表达选择并说明理由的能力；通常针对具体决定评估。

glossary.termEn: durable power of attorney for health care
glossary.defZh: 指定代理人在患者丧失决策能力时代表患者作医疗决定的法律文件。
患者在理解相关风险、获益和替代方案后，自愿拒绝治疗。
经皮内镜胃造瘘管，用于经胃提供营养、水分或药物。
